# HandleRestrict

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Removes permissions from a handle.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x08` SVC_MANAGEHANDLE | `MNGHNDL_RESTRICT (1)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err HandleRestrict(Handle h, HandlePerms mask);
```

**Registers:** `(h, mask) -> r0 status`

Permissions can only be dropped, never added.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to restrict. |
| `mask` | in | Permissions to keep; everything outside it is removed. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
